about_the_game:
Summer is here, and "Tiny Pasture" is making a splash with its new DLC! Get ready to dive into a cool and calming water world.

Your pasture will now transform into a desktop aquarium, where adorable fish will keep you company through work and study. Unlock new fish species, build a lively aquarium, and create your very own mini ocean paradise!

Watch your fish swim freely, interact with them, collect their dropped coins, and expand your aquarium step by step—bringing life and tranquility to your screen!

This DLC includes:

  • Dozens of unique fish species

  • A stunning water-effect background

  • Decorations that drop food for your fish

  • Dynamic, animated decorations

How to add the DLC to your game:

  • Download the DLC

  • Restart Steam or go to Library → Right-click the game → Properties → Installed Files → Verify Integrity of Game Files
